name: VynodeIPTV
description: Preview release for x86-64 Unraid. Native Shield companion with Xtream providers, guide grids, custom channel groups, independent browser video walls, output health diagnostics and server-side HLS remux or CPU conversion. GPU transcoding not implemented. Create a username and password in the WebUI. Existing installations use their previous key once to authorize account setup. Appdata and transcode directories must be writable by UID/GID 10001.

paths.name: Configuration
paths.description: Encrypted state and administrator account; UID 10001 must have write access

paths.name: Scratch
paths.description: Use an existing SSD pool path, writable by UID 10001

paths.name: Recordings
paths.description: Persistent DVR storage; writable by UID/GID 10001. Never use the transcode directory.
